title: fsw-fivestar-2003-tag-team
label: Youth Gone Wild

won.source: A contemporaneous third-party recap of Day of Reckoning, 21 September 2003.

how: Won the vacant title in a five-way gauntlet match that narrowed to a ladder match between Youth Gone Wild and the solo Mason Walker; Walker and Extasy each grabbed one belt off the falling ladder, and Walker was first to his feet with his own belt when Youth Gone Wild's other, previously injured member recovered enough to chairshot him and grab the second belt, giving Youth Gone Wild the win and both titles.
